```plato

    //==
    // Periodicity kit
    //
    // Reduction, wrapping, shortest-arc interpolation, and periodic equality for
    // angles. The canonical interval is the half-open (-pi, pi] (see
    // CONVENTIONS.md - Canonical angle interval): +pi is included, -pi is not,
    // matching the range of atan2. The unit constructors above (n.Degrees,
    // n.Turns, ...) remain the way to BUILD an angle; these reduce and combine
    // existing ones.

    // The angle reduced to the canonical half-open interval (-pi, pi]. Any two
    // angles differing by a whole number of turns map to the same result, so
    // this is the canonical representative of a direction.
    Normalize(self: Angle): Angle {
        var tau = Number.Tau;
        var m = self.Radians - tau * (self.Radians / tau).Floor;
        return Angle(m > Number.Pi ? m - tau : m);
    }
```
